Font.summary: Font resource object that wraps an engine font handle and provides measuring, word wrap, alignment math and drawing

props.classname: Class name identifier, always 'font' (used for theme/style matching)
props.font: Font file name, default "FreeSansBold.otf", loaded through FontHandler.LoadFont
props.size: Font size in pixels, default 12; multiplied by WG.uiScale and rounded down when loading
props.outlineWidth: Outline width, default 2; multiplied by uiScale and rounded to an even number when loading
props.outlineWeight: Outline thickness/blur weight, default 3, passed straight to FontHandler.LoadFont
props.shadow: Draw a text shadow, default false; adds the 's' draw flag only when outline is false
props.outline: Draw a text outline, default false; adds the 'o' draw flag (takes precedence over shadow)
props.autoOutlineColor: Enable the engine's automatic outline color selection, default true

Font:New.desc: Construct a Font instance: call the inherited New, then _LoadFont to load the engine font, and return the new object

params.obj: Property table that overrides the defaults

Font:Dispose.desc: Unload the engine font handle through FontHandler.UnloadFont, then run the inherited Dispose

Font:_LoadFont.desc: Reload the font through FontHandler.LoadFont with size/outline scaled by uiScale, and unload the old handle (internal)

Font:GetLineHeight.desc: Return the line height: _font.lineheight multiplied by size (defaults to self.size)

Font:GetAscenderHeight.desc: Return the ascender height: (lineheight + descender) * size, i.e. unaffected by descenders such as g/p

Font:GetTextWidth.desc: Measure the text width and scale it by size

Font:GetTextHeight.desc: Measure the text height and return the height, the descender height and the line count

Font:WrapText.desc: Word-wrap text to width/height; returns the text unchanged when too small (height < 1.5 lines or width < size) to dodge an old engine bug

Font:AdjustPosToAlignment.desc: Convert the top-left origin into the actual draw anchor for align/valign and return the draw-flag string

params.valign: 'center'/'top'/'bottom'/'linecenter'; anything else is treated as ascender

Font:Draw.desc: Draw one line of text at (x,y) with the current font, color and outline/shadow settings (flips the Y axis internally)

Font:DrawInBox.desc: Draw text aligned inside a rectangle by align/valign; y gets +1 so characters like 'R' are not clipped at the top

fileDesc: Defines the Font class: manages loading/unloading of engine font handles and provides measuring, word wrap, alignment math and drawing (plus the Print/PrintInBox aliases).
